duas.title: Dua for Parents #1
duas.description: Allah commands to be kind and merciful to parents.
duas.translation: My Lord! Have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.

duas.title: Dua for Parents #2
duas.description: Dua made for forgiveness of parents.
duas.translation: O Allah! Forgive me and my parents.

duas.title: Dua for Parents #3
duas.description: Dua for both living and deceased parents.
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا
duas.translation: O Allah! Forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer.

duas.title: Dua for Parents #4
duas.description: Asking Allah to raise parents’ rank in Jannah.
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْفَعْ دَرَجَاتِ وَالِدَيَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
duas.translation: O Allah! Raise the ranks of my parents in Paradise.

duas.title: Dua for Parents #5
duas.description: A beautiful and comprehensive dua for parents’ mercy and forgiveness.
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي بَرًّا بِوَالِدَيَّ فِي حَيَاتِهِمَا وَبَعْدَ مَوْتِهِمَا
duas.translation: O Allah! Make me dutiful to my parents in their lifetime and after their death.

duas.title: Dua for Children #1
duas.description: Asking Allah to protect children from evil.
duas.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قُوا أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا
duas.translation: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire.

duas.title: Dua for Children #2
duas.description: Praying for the welfare and guidance of children.
duas.translation: O Allah! Make them among the people of salvation.

duas.title: Dua for Children #3
duas.description: Praying for the good upbringing of children.
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَلِّمْهُمْ مَا يَنْفَعُهُمْ وَفَقِّهْهُمْ فِي الدِّينِ
duas.translation: O Allah! Teach them what benefits them and give them understanding of the religion.

duas.title: Dua for Children #4
duas.description: Asking for the safety of children from harm.
duas.translation: O Allah! Keep them under Your care and protection.

duas.title: Dua for Children #5
duas.description: Dua for children to become righteous.
duas.translation: O Allah! Make them among the righteous.

duas.title: Dua for Healing #1
duas.description: Praying for complete healing from ailments.
duas.translation: And when I am ill, it is He who heals me.

duas.title: Dua for Healing #2
duas.description: A dua for recovery from sickness.
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ وَاشْفِهِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of the people, remove the harm and cure him, You are the Healer.

duas.title: Dua for Healing #3
duas.description: Dua for relief from pain and suffering.
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِهِ فِي بَدَنِهِ وَفِي رُوحِهِ
duas.translation: O Allah! Grant him well-being in his body and soul.

duas.title: Dua for Healing #4
duas.description: Asking for complete healing from ailments.
duas.translation: O Allah, heal him and relieve him of his distress.

duas.title: Dua for Healing #5
duas.description: A comprehensive prayer for healing from all diseases.
duas.translation: O Allah, cure him and grant him health.

duas.title: Dua for Protection #1
duas.description: Praying for protection from the evil of creation.
duas.translation: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak.'

duas.title: Dua for Protection #2
duas.description: Seeking refuge from the evil of whisperings and harm.
duas.translation: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind.'

duas.title: Dua for Protection #3
duas.description: Asking Allah for protection from all harms.
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَتَ
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what You have created.

duas.title: Dua for Protection #4
duas.description: Praying for protection from all evils of the night.
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of the night when it falls.

duas.title: Dua for Protection #5
duas.description: A prayer for protection from all enemies and harm.
duas.translation: O Allah, protect us from all evil.

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness #1
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا...
duas.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us... we will be among the losers.

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness #2
duas.translation: And seek forgiveness for your sin.

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness #3
duas.description: Best way to ask for forgiveness.
duas.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord... so forgive me.

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness #4
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ
duas.translation: O Allah! Forgive me my past and future sins.

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness #5
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
duas.translation: O Allah, You are Forgiving and love to forgive, so forgive me.

duas.title: Dua Before Sleep #1
duas.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

duas.title: Dua Before Sleep #2
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
duas.translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.

duas.title: Dua Before Sleep #3
duas.translation: With Your name, I live and with Your name, I die.

duas.title: Dua Before Sleep #4
duas.translation: O Allah! Forgive me and have mercy on me.

duas.title: Dua Before Sleep #5
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty.

duas.title: Dua After Waking #1
duas.arabic: الْـحَمْـدُ للهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah Who gave us life after having taken it from us.

duas.title: Dua After Waking #2
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ
duas.translation: O Allah, to You is all praise, You are the Light of the heavens.

duas.title: Dua After Waking #3
duas.translation: O Allah, we have entered morning and the dominion belongs to Allah.

duas.title: Dua After Waking #4
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ
duas.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing I or anyone else has, it is from You alone.

duas.title: Dua After Waking #5
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي رَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي
duas.translation: Praise be to Allah who returned my soul to me.

duas.title: Travel Dua #1
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ... سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest... Glory to Him Who has subjected this to us.

duas.title: Travel Dua #2
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى
duas.translation: O Allah, we ask You for piety and righteousness in this journey.

duas.title: Travel Dua #3
duas.translation: We return, repentant, worshipping, and praising our Lord.

duas.title: Travel Dua #4
duas.translation: O Allah, You are the Companion in travel.

duas.title: Travel Dua #5
duas.translation: O Allah, make us return safe and successful.

duas.title: Dua for Rizq #1
duas.description: Asking for good in this world.
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good.

duas.title: Dua for Rizq #2
duas.description: Request for a feast from heaven.
duas.translation: O Allah! Provide for us, and You are the best of providers.

duas.title: Dua for Rizq #3
duas.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful instead of what is unlawful.

duas.title: Dua for Rizq #4
duas.translation: O Allah, bless me in my provision.

duas.title: Dua for Rizq #5
duas.translation: O Allah! Enrich me with Your bounty from others.

duas.title: Dua for Anxiety #1
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
duas.translation: O Allah! I seek refuge in You from worry and grief.

duas.title: Dua for Anxiety #2
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا
duas.translation: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy.

duas.title: Dua for Anxiety #3
duas.translation: O Allah, calm my heart and grant me serenity.

duas.title: Dua for Anxiety #4
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ ضِيقِ الصَّدْرِ
duas.translation: O Allah! I seek refuge from the tightness of chest.

duas.title: Dua for Anxiety #5
duas.description: Trust in Allah in difficult times.
duas.translation: Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best disposer of affairs.
